name: run-task-end-to-end
description: Carry a task from natural-language intake through project verification and requested local or PR/MR delivery using the active client's workspace behavior.
dependencies: the active AI client's native workspace support when isolation is selected
profileAssumptions: Accepts a natural-language task and materials with optional base, target, branch, workspace, phase, and verification hints; repository and profile policies define any additional required inputs.
Treats shorthand values as prompt text rather than a rigid cross-client argument grammar.
Uses native client workspace behavior when available and verifies the actual Git checkout before editing.
Resolves and verifies a task branch from the exact base commit before editing, following repository and profile branch policy.
Follows repository and profile branch policy rather than duplicating branch rules.
Uses project setup and client-supported ignored-file inclusion; does not provide generic port or service isolation.
A target branch or explicit publish request selects PR/MR delivery after verification and any chosen user-review gate.
